Overview

Alajuela is a city in AL with a population of 300,000. A city near the international airport, known for its pleasant climate, mango trees, and proximity to Poás Volcano. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 12b growing zone supports Tropical — year-round growing, tropical crops. Reported crime rates are relatively high. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.0.
